## Overview

Resizable Panel — one pane of an `<art-resizable>` group. Sizes are percentages.

## Properties

| Property      | Attribute      | Description                                               | Type                  | Default     |
| ------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- | ----------- |
| `defaultSize` | `default-size` | Initial size in %; panels without one share what is left. | `number \| undefined` | `undefined` |
| `maxSize`     | `max-size`     |                                                           | `number`              | `100`       |
| `minSize`     | `min-size`     |                                                           | `number`              | `10`        |
| `size`        | `size`         | Current size in %, kept by the group.                     | `number`              | `0`         |
